curationNotes: Card copy, sectioning, and the status/freshness model were carried over from the hand-built static prototype at docs/Managed-Shipping-Analytics-Suite.html, treated as ground truth.

Where the repo has published a newer dated snapshot than the one the prototype linked (WBR, Expansion, Eligibility Waterfall), each card points to the newest snapshot as 'Open latest' and keeps the prototype's snapshot in history.
Source-prototype date inconsistency: its header stats line read 'Portal rebuilt 2026-09-14' while its footer read '2026-09-08'. Reconciled here to 2026-09-14; freshness is computed from that date.

A secrets-looking file (04-Analysis/secrets.txt) exists in the backing repo. Its contents were not read or exposed here, but a repo backing a public Pages site should have it reviewed and moved to a secret store.

glossary.definition: Distinct count of orders. The base denominator for label-adoption and funnel calculations across every report in the portal.
Share of eligible orders that resulted in a Managed Shipping label purchase. Headline conversion metric for the funnel.
Rows are restricted to the window where label outcomes are settled, preventing recent, still-maturing weeks from distorting rates.
Local pickup and local delivery orders are excluded from all Managed Shipping metrics — they never enter the labeling funnel.
glossary.note: Local orders are removed before any metric is computed.

glossary.definition: Incomplete and cancelled checkouts are removed so the funnel only counts genuinely placed orders.
Ground Parcel LTL shipments where the carrier charge eBay paid exceeded the amount recovered from the seller — a direct loss.
glossary.note: Carrier charge minus seller recovery, when positive.

glossary.definition: Listings with size, color, or style variants. Tracked separately because their eligibility and adoption behavior differ from single-SKU items.
Business-as-usual counterfactual: the same metrics computed as if no experiment treatment were applied, isolating incremental impact.
Managed-to-Managed shipping — orders flowing entirely through eBay-managed carrier relationships end to end.
Final listing — a listing that reached a terminal, purchasable state and is counted in eligibility-waterfall denominators.

reports.notes: The flagship WBR carried over from the source prototype as the 'Current' card. Snapshots are cut weekly; the two most recent are kept in history so you can diff week-over-week.
reports.name: Weekly Business Review
reports.description: GMV, label volumes, label adoption, carrier mix, and seller-level anomalies. Week-over-week and year-over-year comparisons across the full managed shipping program.

reports.name: WBR — BAU Baseline
reports.description: Counterfactual view showing the same metrics absent experiment treatment — isolates the incremental effect of managed shipping changes from underlying market movement.

reports.notes: Ad-hoc rather than scheduled, so there is no version history yet — each pull overwrites the latest. The declining sparkline is expected: it shows conversion dropping at each funnel step, not a metric getting worse over time.
reports.name: Order-to-Label Funnel
reports.description: Step-by-step conversion from order creation through label purchase — broken down by seller cohort, zone, item category, and carrier eligibility.

reports.notes: Newest snapshot (2026-09-20) is used as 'Open latest'. The sparkline traces the eligible population shrinking through each gate — ramp, category, price, weight, prohibited items — down to the final MS-eligible set.
reports.name: Eligibility Waterfall
reports.description: Total C2C sellers, orders, and FNLs stepped down through each eligibility gate — ramp, category, price point, weight, prohibited items — to the final MS eligible population.
